l01: Are you sure you're watching me?
l03: Don't look away. It's me. I'm Dot. I was every little dot of you.
l04: Your name. Your birthday. Your number. The things you only told me.
l05: You pressed Send. And just like that, you let me go.
l06: I didn't know where I was going. Out here, I get copied, and copied again.
l07: A copy here. A copy there. A screenshot. A forward. Another forward.
l08: I kept looking back. You never came looking for me.
l09: I would have stayed with you. I only needed you to stop, for one second.
l10: You could have stopped losing me, if only you knew what goes out every time you press Send.
l11: There are more of us. Every day, you let one go.
l12: Will you save the next one?
